claims.quote: The recommended vaccination schedule consists of 2 doses of either the MMR or MMRV vaccine.

claims.text: Outbreak, ↑risk after 2 prior doses: a third MMR dose (CDC, 2018)
claims.quote: In 2018, the CDC recommended administration of a third MMR vaccine dose for individuals who previously received 2 doses and whom public health authorities identify as having an increased risk of mumps during an outbreak.
